msContents.summary: This is a paper manuscript of the Itihāsasamuccaya. It breaks off at the beginning of the 20th story.

lg.l: kathayaṃtaṃ hitārthāya prabhāvānn adbhutāṃs tathā

lomaśaṃ dharmatatvajñaṃ paryyapṛchad yu
dhiṣṭiraḥ 1

tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yat syā
t_ tan me brūhi tapodhanaḥ 2

ekato bhayabhī
tasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇaṃ 3

prāṇarakṣā nṛṇām eva sa

a
tha taṃ nṛpatiṃ prāpya kapotaḥ syenajād bhayāt
śaraṇārthī mahīpālaṃ nililye bhayavihvalaḥ 7

tataḥ
sanair upāgamya syenarūpī sureśvaraḥ
rājānaṃ sumahātmānaṃ provācedaṃ vacas tadā 8

dharmā
tmānaṃ tvāṃ prāhur ekaṃ rājan mahīkṣitam
satvaṃ dharmmavirūpaṃ hi kathaṃ dharmaṃ cikīrṣasi 9

bhavān kṛtaghnaṃ
dānena satyenānṛtavādināṃ
kṣamayāt krūrakarmmāṇaḥ asādhuṃ sādhukarmaṇā 10

nopakāraparepy eva
m upakāraparo janaḥ
apakārapare pī tvam upakāraparo yathā 11

ahite tvaṃ hito pāpe tvam apāpo si sa
rvadā
doṣānveṣaṇadakṣo pi guṇānveṣaṇatatpara 12
tad evaṃ vihito bhakṣaṃ pīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā

kapo
taḥ tvatsamīpasyaṃ tan me dehy avilaṃvitaḥ
mā hiṃsī lobhito dharmaṃ dharmam utsṛjyamānasaṃ 13
saṃtrastarūpaprāṇārthī tvatto bhīto vihaṃgama
matsaraṇaṃ samanuprāptaṃ prāṇagṛdhnurayaṃ khagaḥ 14

tad e
vam āgatasyāsya kapotasya kapotasya bhayātmanaḥ
katham asmadvidhaḥ kuryāt_ tyāgaṃ sarvavigarhitaṃ 15
lobhād dveṣād bhayād vāpi yas tyajet saraṇāgataṃ
brahmahatyāsahasrasya pāpam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ 16

sāstre
ṣu niṃditaḥ so pi mahāpātakavān api
saraṇāgatahaṃtus tu na dṛṣṭā niḥkṛtiḥ kvacit 17

yathātmanaḥ
priyā prāṇāḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā
tasmān mṛtyubhayād eva trātavyā prāṇino budhaiḥ 18

janmamṛtyu
jarāduḥkhair nityaṃ saṃsārasāgare
jaṃtavaḥ parikliśyaṃte mṛtyos trasyaṃti te tathā 19

yaṃ nimittaṃ bhavec cho
kas trāso vā duḥkham eva ca
āyāso vā yato mūla sa sneham api taṃ tyajet 20

marīṣyāmīti yad duḥkhaṃ
puruṣasyopajāyate
yuktaṃ tenānumānena paro pi parirakṣitum 21

yathā ca te jīvitam ātmanaḥ priyaṃ
tathā pareṣām api jīvitaṃ priyaṃ
saṃrakṣase jīvitam ātmano yathā tathā pareṣām api raksa jīvitaṃ 22
tasmān nāham imaṃ bhītam arppayiṣye kapotakam
yad atra yuktaṃ manyaṃte karttuṃ syenāśu tad vada 23

prāyasaḥ puru
ṣā loke sarvabhūtadayāparāḥ
mahatām api yajñānāṃ kālena kṣiyate phalaṃ 24

dattam iṣṭaṃ tathā taptaṃ tī
rthasevā śutas tathā
sarvābhayapradānasya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśī 25

saptasāgaraparyaṃtāṃ yo dadyāt
pṛthivīm imāṃ
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyas tayor abhayado dhikaḥ 26

apī tyajed rājyam idaṃ śarīraṃ vā sudu
styajaṃ
na tv enaṃ bhayasaṃtrastaṃ tyajed dīnaṃ kapotakam 27

yan mamāstī śubhaṃ kiṃcit_ kṛtaṃ janmani janma
ni
bhavet trātā bhayārttānāṃ ārttināśāyadehinām 28
na hi vā kāmaye rājyaṃ na svargāṃ nāpunarbhavam
prāṇināṃ duḥkhataptānāṃ kāmayed duḥkhanāśanam 29
yathā ca nānṛtāṃ vācām aham evam udāhare

satyenāne
na bhagavān_ prasīdatu maheśvaraḥ 30
āhārārthaṃ samāraṃbhas tava cāyaṃ vihaṃgama

tava preṣṭaṃ tavāhāraṃ a
nyam eva kathasva tvam 31
ya evaṃ vihitāsmākaṃ dhātrā bhakṣakapotakam

tam evotsṛja nā
hāraiḥ kāryam anyair nareśvara 32
āhārāt sarvabhūtāni saṃbhavaṃti nareśvara

āhāreṇa vivarddhaṃte tena jīvaṃ
ti jaṃtavaḥ 33
sakyate duḥkare py arthe citraṃ rātropajīvitam

na tv āhāravihīnena śakyaṃ varttayituṃ ciram
34
bhakṣād vilopya tasyāsya mama praṇā viśāṃ pate
visṛjya kāyaṃ yāsyaṃti paṃthānam apunarbhavam 35
mṛtaṃ ca me mama sarve putradāra mariṣyati
rakṣamāṇaḥ kapotaṃ tvaṃ bahupraṇān nariṣyasi 36

dharmaṃ yo bādhate dharma na
sa dharma paraṃtapa
avirodhī tu yo dharmaḥ sa dharmaḥ sadbhir ucyate 37

tasmād virodhe dharmasya viciṃtya gurulā
ghavam
yato bhūyāṃs tato rājan_ kuru dharmmavinirṇaya 38

nāsmād dharmaparo bhūyān kaści
d anyo sti khecara
prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānām abhayaṃ yat pradīyate 39

varam ekasya satvasya dadyād abhaya
dakṣiṇām
na tu viprasahasrasya gosahasraphalaṃ samaṃ 40

abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayāpa
raḥ
tasya dehād vimuktasya bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit 41
hemadhenudharādīnāṃ dātāra sulabhā bhuvi
durllabha puruṣo loke sarvabhūtadayāparaḥ 42

syenāḥ kapotān khādaṃti śrutir eṣā sa
nātanī
mā rājan saratāṃ jñātvā kadalīskaṃdham āruha 43

nāhaṃ kuśāstramārgeṇa kvacid vartte
vihaṃgama
śāstreṇaivopadiṣṭo yaṃ dharmasatvadayāparaḥ 44
sarvasatveṣu yad dānam ekaśatve ca yad dayā
sarvasatvapradānāt tu dayaikasmin viśiṣyate 45
sarvavedā na tat kuryuḥ sarvayajñāś ca khecara

sarvatī
rthābhiṣekaś ca yaḥ kuryāt prāṇināṃ dayā 46
vāṅmanaḥkarmmabhir ye tu sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ

dayā darśitapa
thāno brahmalokaṃ vrajaṃti te 47
gacchatas tiṣṭato vāpi jāgrata svapato pi vā

yaṃ na bhūtahitā
rthāya tat paśor iva ceṣṭitaṃ 48
prāṇināṃ vadhyamānānāṃ yaḥ kaścit samapekṣa

sa yāti narake gho
re iti prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ 49
sumahat sulabhaṃ rājyaṃ prayacchāmi tava dvija

yadi kāmayaṣye nyaṃ vā va
rjayitvā kapotakaṃ 50
yadi rājan kapotena sudṛḍhā prītir īdṛśī

tattvaṃ kapotatu
lyani svamāṃsāni prayaccha me 51
anugraham imaṃ manye yan māṃ śyenābhiyācase

eta
t te saṃprayacchāmi svamāṃsaṃ yāvad icchasi 52
yad apriyaṃ tat sujanaḥś ciraṃ vadati vā na vā

mama tu
priyam evaitat_ kasyābhivāṃchitaṃ hitaṃ 53
adhruveṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇavināśinā

dhruvaṃ yo
nārjjate dharma sa śocyo muḍhacetanaḥ 54
yadi prāṇyupakārāya deho yaṃ nopajāyate

tataḥ kiṃ
m upacāro sya pratyahaṃ kriyate vṛthā 55
nātiriktam ahaṃ yāce tava māṃsaṃ janeśvara
tasmāt kapotena dhṛṃtaṃ prayachatu mayā samaṃ 56

tad evāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yan māṃsenābhi
yācase
śyenāsya rakṣaṇaṃ yan me tavāpi ca vihaṃgama 57

evam uktvā svamāṃsā
ni samutkṛtya sa pārthivaḥ 58
prakṛṣṭas tolayāmāsa kapotena saha prabhuḥ 58

tyaktvātmasukha
bhogecchāṃ sarvasatvasukhaisiṇāṃ
bhavaṃti paraduḥkhena sādhavo nityaduḥkhitāḥ 59

dhṛyamāṇas tu tu
tulayā kapoto hy atyaricyate
punaś cotkṛtya māṃsāni tataḥ prādāt sa pārthivaḥ 60

na vidyate yathā
māṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ kvacit
tataḥ prakṣīṇamāṃso sau āruroha svayaṃ tulām 61

paraduḥkhāturo ni
nityaṃ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ
nopekṣaṃte mahātmānas svasukhāni mahāṃty api 62

atha tasmin samārūḍho tulā
m auśīnare nṛpe
devaduṃdubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ca 63

tatas tasya tadā jñātvā devarājo dhṛtiṃ
parāṃ
śakraḥ svarūpam āsthāya vācam etad abhāṣata 64

iṃdro ham asmi bhadraṃ te kapoto havya
vāhanaḥ
jijñāsamānau tvāṃ dreaṣṭam imaṃ yajñam upāgatau 65
naitat pūrvanṛpāś cakrur na kariṣyaṃti cāpare
mahākāruṇikeneha yat kṛtaṃ duskaraṃ nṛpa 66
parārthe tyajataḥ prāṇān yā prītir abhavat tava

prāṇasaṃśaya
lubdheṣu na sā prāṇesu dehināṃ 67
parārthekāṃtakalyāṇī svaśreyo tyaṃtaniṣṭurā

tvayaiva kevalaṃ rā
jan_ kalyāṇataruṇāyate 68
svakarmmapāśaiḥ sudṛḍhaiḥ baddhaṃ kṛtsnam idaṃ jagat

tvaṃ ca duḥkhakhyamokṣārthaṃ
baddhaḥ karuṇayā nṛpaḥ 69
tathā sarvātmanā cāpi doṣo py apahṛtaṃ tvayā

yathā caivātmnaḥ sthāne vāsa
nān aviśeṣitā 70
akṛtverthaṃ viśiṣṭeṣu hinān anavamanya ca

akṛtvā sādṛśai sparddhāṃ tvaṃ lokotta
matāṃ gataḥ 71
ātmaprāṇai parā prāṇān_ yo naraḥ parirakṣati
sa yāti tatparamaṃ sthānaṃ yato nāvarttate punaḥ 72
prāṇair api tvayā rājan_ rakṣitaḥ kṛpaṇo janaḥ
svamāṃsāny api dattāni dravyeṣv anyeṣu kā kathā 73

paśa
vo pi hi jīvaṃti kevalātmodaraṃbharāḥ
sa purna jīvitaṃ ślāghyo yat parārthaṃ ca jīvati 74

kiṃ cā
tra citraṃ yat saṃtaḥ parānugrahatatparāḥ
na hi svadehaśītyāya jāyaṃteś cāndanadrumāḥ 75

paropakāravyā
pāraḥ paro yaḥ puruṣaḥ sadā
sa padaṃ tad avāpnoti parād api hi tat param 76

paropakāraikadhiyaḥ svasu
kheṣu gataspṛhā
jagaddhitāya jāyaṃte sādhavas tv ādṛśā bhuvi 77

yat svamāṃsāni gātrebhyaḥ samadattā
ni pārthiva
iha te śāsvatī divyaṃ svargalokaṃ ca yāsyasi 78

divyarūpadharaś caiva pālayītvā ca me
dinīm
sarvān lokān atikramya brahmalokaṃ ca yāsyasi 79

evam uktvā tu iṃdrā
gnī jagmutus tridaśālayam
rājāpi kratum iṣṭvā ca mumude devavac ciraṃ 80

ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ śive
ś caritam uttama
sa vidhūyeha pāpāni prayāti paraṃ padam 81

viciṃtya rājā svaśarīram adhruvaṃ dhruvaṃ
yas sarvasya janasya durllabham
śarīradānāt parajīvarakṣaṇaṃ vidhāya lokatrayabhūṣaṇaṃ yayau 82
